name: openrouter-prices
source: OpenRouter's public model list, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (no key), each model's pricing.prompt, pricing.completion and pricing.input_cache_read, in dollars per token, multiplied here by one million
notes: List prices on the day fetched, not a quote; OpenRouter can change them at any time, and the provider it routes a call to may bill differently (RV-DES-11).
openai/gpt-5.6-terra lists a higher price for prompts of 272,000 tokens or more (4 and 18 dollars per million); no registered call is estimated that large, so the base price is used.

deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813 lists 1.32 in and 3.96 out on the second fetch of 2026-11-20 (0.22 and 9.5 on the first, an earlier state of the list), where pi-ai 1.3.0's catalogue (2026-10-15) lists 0.66 in and 1.98 out. deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash moved the same way (0.051 and 0.567 to 0.3 and 1.2). Prices are volatile within a day: recheck on the day of the run.
openai/gpt-4.1 stands for tau2-bench's retail judge and user simulator, gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 upstream; OpenRouter lists no dated id for it.

openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (the lead's M2) lists 0.0399 in, 0.0784 out and 0.03 cache read per million (pricing 0.0000000399, 0.0000000784, 0.00000003 per token); also listed are glm-5.3-flashx, glm-5.3-prime and a ~z-ai/glm-flash-latest alias, none of them used.
refetched: 2026-11-20, after the first fetch (response 3005b45c...b6cb0, 479 models, 927,325 bytes) priced deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813 at 0.22 in and 9.5 out; a second fetch the same day returned identical bytes, sha256 above
